newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: St George eyes exotic capital raising plans.
newsitem.headline: St George eyes exotic capital raising plans.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Friday it was currently examining various exotic structures through which it could conduct its planned A$360 million capital raising.

"It's a question of trying to come up with a structure which is least dilutionary in terms of ROE (return on equity)," St George Bank Managing Director Jim Sweeney told reporters after a speech to the Institute of Chartered Accountants.
"There are some exotic structures around that, if you can can make them work, can give you the capital you need and minimise the impact on ROE," Sweeney said.
He said the bank was working through various options provided by investment banks and had no specific deadline for the capital raising.
He would not give any details on what form the capital raising, which was announced on October 14 last year, would take.
"A range of investment banks have put to us a range of options, some of them vanilla, some of them quite exotic. We are running them all down to try to come with the best solution for us," he said.
The capital raising was designed to help finance the now-completed merger with Advance Bank and keep the bank's capital adequacy ratio over 10 percent.
